fixed.problem: L4-creds-2: Agent SDK 0.3.304 throws after Claude Code's error result. A refused sign-in read as Failed, Settings kept saying 'Works now', chat said 'I could not answer', every later call went to the refused sign-in again, and Costs listed '<synthetic>'.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-sdk-throw.test.ts > "a refused sign-in under 'then wait' is one refused card and a waiting task; chat holds; no second request; no '<synthetic>' in Costs" (plus the throwing-fake cases in sdk-driver.test.ts and claude-code-provider.test.ts, describe "l4-cred-engine, run L4")
fixed.how: SdkAgentDriver reads the iterator through its own then(), so a throw ends the loop the same way the stream's end does, and the same mapping runs after it (usage limit, authentication_failed, the error result's verdict, error_max_budget_usd). A thrown text with no verdict before it is read by its own words, with the token cut out. ClaudeCodeProvider yields the stream's verdict from its catch. Claude Code's synthetic error message (model '<synthetic>', zero usage) is not a model call and is never booked. REFUSED_TEXT also matches 'Authentication error ·' and 'OAuth access token is invalid'.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Set up a project whose subscription sign-in has expired and press Start. The Inbox shows one card, 'Anthropic refused your Claude sign-in'. The task shows 'Waits for a new Claude sign-in', not Failed. Settings shows the subscription as Refused. Asking chat a question gets 'Anthropic refused your Claude sign-in, so I have not answered. Sign in again in Settings; ...'. Costs lists no '<synthetic>' model.

fixed.problem: L4-creds-1: A run that hit the subscription's plan share mid-run became a budget pause with a budget card waiting until the 1st, whatever policy the person chose. Raising the allowance in Settings did not end it.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-share-midrun.test.ts > "under 'then the API key' the work goes on on the key from its kept work; no budget card" (and the ask/wait/raise cases); apps/ui/test/settings-plan-allowance.test.tsx new case; real-daemon describe 'l4-cred-engine, run L4'
fixed.how: The executor now reads a run's budget_exceeded at level 'plan' on the subscription as the credential stop 'share' (Run outcome usage_limit, artifact credentialStop share; report and handoff kept). The policy then decides: next, ask or wait, with the wait lasting until the next month's start. takeReady holds share and key_month waits. planUsageOf counts reported shares only from limits.planAllowanceSetAt. POST /settings/plan-allowance returns changeLine through billing.waits.allowanceRaised().
fixed.check_in_the_app: Set a small plan allowance and the policy 'Subscription first, then API key', then start a session. When the share is reached the task goes on with the API key and no budget card appears. Under 'then wait', the session ends waiting until the 1st. new_problems: scrubEnv in agent/sdk.ts passes the host's CLAUDE* and CCR_* variables to the Claude Code subprocess. With them, the real-SDK contract test took about 245 s, so packages/runtime/test/sdk-contract.test.ts hides /^(CCR_|CLAUDE|https?_proxy$|NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS$)/i. A daemon started from a shell that has those set would leak them to every task run.
A critic review that meets the plan share is still a budget pause (the runner's review path, around the l4-money-pause region), not the credential stop 'share' that the executor now gives a task run.
validZone still falls back to UTC for a missing zone. The callers in this area now read the person row at each use, but other users of validZone keep the fallback.
Scheduled jobs (calibration, model watch) read the person's zone at start, not at each use as the credential sentences now do.
docs:check in pnpm check diffs against origin/main, which this checkout lacks, so it prints 'nothing to check'. Run it with DOCS_CHECK_BASE=<base> in worktrees.

The bench walk used --provider bench-api (the Messages API stand-in, no real key, no money), not --provider bench. --provider bench injects a provider and bypasses the credential policy, so none of this area's paths can be walked on it. bench-live was never used.
notes_for_other_areas: failureReply(error) in packages/runtime/src/conversation/depth.ts returns {text, askAgain}: one sentence per error code, never the error's message. A chat.reply row for a failed answer is a notice and carries failed:true where Ask again helps; the conversation view's turn.failed shows Ask again, and the UI never shows Think it through under it.

chatHoldReply (session/credential-words.ts) now depends on the reason and ends 'I can still add and change tasks.' for every stop (no 'move and start'). A refused credential gets 'Save a new key in Settings' or 'Sign in again in Settings'.
StreamEvent 'error' may carry billing (CallBilling), and collectStream keeps it as ModelResponse.billing. The loop applies it with takeBilling before booking a cut-off call.
RouteContext.nowMs is required (billing router). The cloud runner passes its clock (PickRunnerBillingOptions.clock).
AskAnswerDeps.onGrant(sourceId, projectIds, {since, again}). The ask card's change_card carries applying {stopKey, at} while an apply is under way.
SdkDriverDeps.baseURL is set from config.anthropicApiBase; the default address is never sent.
compose's chatRoom can return level 'plan' (the subscription's share room) beside 'month' and 'project'.
PlanAllowanceView.changeLine, billing.waits.allowanceRaised() and limits.planAllowanceSetAt (L4-creds-1). Reported plan shares count only from the allowance's last change.
resultAfterWait (daemon/run-indicator.ts) also rewrites CE-7's ask form once its card is no longer open. Every reader of a stored result should keep going through it.
Run indicator: pendingPersonStarts includes starts by 'continuation', so nextProject names a queued continuation.

Test helpers: cred-world.ts gained setProviderScript (hold a chat or provider call on Claude Code), setKey('error') (the API's 500), the apiBase option (a config.json), and exports syntheticError, sdkThrow, REFUSED_SIGN_IN_TEXT and providerReply. testenv's Messages API stand-in has KeyAnswer {kind:'error'}.

blocking.issue: L4-creds-8: chat's 'start a session' under a refused credential does not give the Start dialog's sentence once a session has met the refusal. That is the usual way a person finds a refusal: they press Start. Chat answers with a sentence that names no action and disagrees with the dialog on screen at the same moment.
blocking.evidence: Bench walk A (bench-api, --api-key refused, zone Europe/Zurich): Start session, then Start; the run meets the 401; the refused card is filed and the session ends to wait with a kept continuation. Chat 'start a session' then replies 'Your session of 09:23 goes on by itself once its Claude credential is back.' (no read-back). The Start dialog shows 'Nothing can run until you save a new API key in Settings.' with Start disabled. Files: /tmp/frbench/review-l4-cred-engine/steps/06-a-chat-start-refused-key.png, /tmp/frbench/review-l4-cred-engine/steps/08-a-start-dialog-after-refusal.png and /tmp/frbench/review-l4-cred-engine/evidence/walk-a.json (chatStart vs dialogBlocked). Cause: the chat startBlocked port passes the wait only when `w?.save && !w.startable && !w.kept`. The `!w.kept` exclusion was meant for a resting credential's kept 'Start at 15:40', but it also drops a refused credential's wait whenever a continuation is kept. session.start then falls through to the continuations' waiting sentence (compose.ts:4298, 'once its Claude credential is back'), which does not say to save a new key (design §5 rule 8). credential-chat-refused.test.ts only covers chat before any session has run, so the common path is untested. docs/user-guide.md and the ADR 0120 amendment (point 6) both state chat's start gets the dialog's sentence.
blocking.expected: Per the acceptance line 'Chat "start a session" gets the dialog's sentence with no read-back', a refused credential's chat start says 'Nothing can run until you save a new API key in Settings.' (or the sign-in form), whether or not a continuation or start is kept. Keep the `kept` exception only for a resting credential. Add the composed case: Start by POST /sessions, the run meets the refusal, then chat 'start a session'. Assert reply === start-check blocked.sentence and no pendingConfirmation.

fixed.problem: Blocking (review of L4-creds-8). Usually a person finds out about a refusal by pressing Start: the run meets the 401, the refused card is filed, and the session ends but is kept to go on (S-10). After that, chat's 'start a session' said 'Your session of 09:23 goes on by itself once its Claude credential is back.'. That sentence names no step. At the same moment the Start dialog said 'Nothing can run until you save a new API key in Settings.' with Start off.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-chat-refused.test.ts > "a refused key met by the person's Start: chat's start says the dialog's sentence, also after a restart" and "a refused sign-in met by the person's Start: chat's start says the dialog's sentence" (both got 'Your session of 10:00 goes on by itself once its Claude credential is back.'); packages/commands/test/start-refusal-order.test.ts > 'both ports answer: the dialog's refusal is said, at the read-back and at the yes, and nothing starts'
fixed.how: There were two causes, and both are fixed. (1) Chat's startBlocked port in compose.ts passed the credential wait only when `w.save && !w.startable && !w.kept`. The `!w.kept` exclusion was meant for a resting credential. It also dropped a refused credential's wait whenever a session was kept. A resting wait never carries a save link, so `save` alone identifies a refusal. The port now passes `w.save && !w.startable`. (2) session.start (packages/commands/src/commands/session.ts) checked refuseWhileWaiting (startWaits, the one-wait rule) before refuseBlockedStart. Both plan() and run() now check refuseBlockedStart first: the dialog's refusal comes first, then the one-wait rule. A resting credential still gets the one-wait sentence ('Your session of 10:00 goes on by itself at 15:40.'), because chat's port does not treat a resting wait as a refusal.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Set up a project with only a refused API key (policy 'API key only') and one ready task. Press Start session, then Start. The Inbox shows 'Anthropic refused your API key', and the bar reads 'Field notes · waiting for a new API key, then it goes on'. In the project's Chat, type 'start a session'. The reply is 'Nothing can run until you save a new API key in Settings.', with no Yes/No, and no new session starts. Open Start session: the dialog shows the same sentence and Start is off. Quit and reopen Forerunner, then type 'start a session' again: the reply is the same. For a refused Claude sign-in under 'Subscription first, then wait', the reply is 'Nothing can run until you save a new Claude sign-in in Settings.'. Live check (session lead, real model): run the same steps with an expired subscription sign-in. The chat reply must equal the Start dialog's sentence word for word.
